notes.title: The UI pop-up issue has been resolved
notes.notes:
20231014
Thanks to the support of the players, I finally found the reason why the UI was causing the jumps, it was that some of the code values in my hand rubbed progress bar were not completely zeroed out. These are leftover issues from my past handwritten code. I'm sorry for the many players that have been bothered by this issue.
Indeed it is an error that a decent programmer might not produce. Please feel free to support players who enjoy this game.
The jumping out issue has been fixed


After the current version of the game was put on the shelves yesterday (2023.10.12), players responded to a lot of problems.
This is all due to my personal inexperience in development, and I would like to apologize for this, because I am worried that I can't see it by posting an announcement, so I wrote it synchronously on the front page of the store page.

The related problems have been solved:
1, due to the data did not realize the separation of front and back, resulting in the background AI event refresh, affecting the player's UI interface data, resulting in the wrong length of data, resulting in a jump. We apologize to all players.
2、Adjustments have been made to the number of AI troop configurations
a. Reduced the troop refresh of the Yellow Turban Army.
b. Reduced the number of troops refreshed by the historical ruling forces.
c. Increased the base Troops limit.
3、Substantially reduced the requirement of reputation and official position for recruiting generals, and at the same time lowered the difficulty evaluation of recruiting generals.
4. Added some hints

[strike]The current version of the playability is there, but there are the following problems:
1, due to the instability brought by the hand rubbing UI, resulting in some players appearing to jump out more frequently.
2、The push message of many events is not enough, or the help information is not enough, leading to the player for the event after the occurrence of the lack of sufficient information to judge
3, in the stage of attacking the city, the number of AI troop configuration is unreasonable, resulting in players attacking the city is difficult.
4. Lack of automatic archiving.
[b]Therefore, I would like to sincerely suggest that players who like this game should hold off on purchasing it, please add a wish list and pay attention to the subsequent updates[/b].
What I immediately need to address at the moment is:
[strike]1, automatic archiving to protect player progress.[/strike]
2, systematically adjust the AI troop configuration and related parameters to ensure that the difficulty is appropriate, so that players can successfully attack the city and dominate.
The above matters will be debugged in the near future[/strike]


Recent goals:
1、Increase console function.
2、Replace the UI module to completely solve the UI stability problem.
Any questions or comments can be feedback to me.

Thank you for your tolerance and support.
Let's work together to perfect this game.

notes.title: Sinoepoch Games Upcoming Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]The game is due to be released on October 12, 2023 at 14:00 BST (October 11, 23:00 PDT).[/b]

The game begins in 184 A.D. Players choose a local Clan as their family background to start a life of chaos.

The game experience is divided into three phases: [i]Individual Play[/i], [i]Forces Rising[/i], and [i]Kingdom Battle[/i].

[u]Individual Play: [/u]
When the player has no power, he moves as a free trader.
[u]Forces Rising: [/u]
Players become the leader of a force through the imperial court or the family's self-establishment, starting from a county magistrate to fight for the world.
[u]Kingdom Battle:[/u]
After the player has become a Zhoumu, there will be factions within the force. At the same time, the player can further claim the title of King until he becomes the Emperor.


I apologize that the game does not currently support English and other languages. I'll be working on remaking the UI code to support multiple local languages.
For foreign players who like this kind of game, please add it to your wishlist and watch for updates!

notes.title: 致歉公告_关于游戏 治夏 Sinoepoch 的改期发布说明
notes.notes:
"Due to the advice of my friends, I was suggested to continue perfecting the game content before releasing it, in order to give players a more complete gaming experience, rather than releasing it prematurely and slowly making up for it later. I listened to my friends' opinions and realized that my previous decision was very hasty. I should continue to improve the game before releasing it.

During this process, I will also continue to release new progress reports. There are definitely various difficulties in the development process, both in terms of development and inner struggles. When there are mistakes, we must admit them, and when there are difficulties, we must solve them.

In any case, the ultimate goal is to produce a fun game. I hereby make this announcement to apologize to everyone and express my gratitude for your support."
